ai_overview.markdown:
An eternity ring is a metal band set with a continuous line of identically cut gemstones—usually diamonds—that symbolizes `never-ending love and an unbreakable commitment`.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eternity_ring)[[2]](https://www.camelliarts.com/wedding-rings/eternity-ring-meaning-guide/)

### Core Meaning and History

- **Everlasting Love:** Because the circular metal band has no beginning and no end, it represents a loop of infinite affection.[[1]](https://www.camelliarts.com/wedding-rings/eternity-ring-meaning-guide/)
- **Ancient Roots:** The concept dates back over 4,000 years to [Ancient Egypt](https://www.diamondmansion.com/blog/what-is-an-eternity-ring/) , where rings made of bone, beads, or metal signified eternal life and the circle of life.[[1]](https://www.diamondmansion.com/blog/what-is-an-eternity-ring/)[[2]](https://www.beaverbrooks.co.uk/eternity-ring-buying-guide)
- **Modern Tradition:** Popularized as commercial jewelry in the 1960s, they are traditionally given by a spouse to mark major relationship milestones.[[1]](https://www.danarebeccadesigns.com/blogs/drd-blog/what-is-an-eternity-ring-when-to-buy)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eternity_ring)

### When to Give an Eternity Ring

- **Milestone Anniversaries:** Frequently presented on significant years like a 10th or 25th wedding anniversary.
- **The Birth of a Child:** Often used as a "push present" to celebrate a new family member.
- **Vow Renewals:** Used to reaffirm lifelong promises.[[1]](https://www.camelliarts.com/wedding-rings/eternity-ring-meaning-guide/)

### Full vs. Half Eternity Rings

- **Full Eternity:** Features gemstones going all the way around the entire circumference of the band for maximum sparkle, though it is harder to resize.
- **Half Eternity:** Features stones set only across the top half of the ring, offering more everyday comfort and easier resizing.[[1]](https://www.camelliarts.com/wedding-rings/eternity-ring-meaning-guide/)
